This concept explores a dual-mode energy scavenger: a broadband RF rectenna paired with a piezoelectric membrane tuned to common urban vibration bands. The goal is a postage-stamp module that keeps low-power IoT nodes alive without batteries.

A modular ceramic lattice designed to sit in intertidal zones. As water flows through honeycomb channels, density and surface chemistry pull microplastics into replaceable cartridges. No motors — only tide and gravity.
